item.title: Thunderstorm Advisory No. 4 #NCRPRSD
item.description:
Thunderstorm Advisory No. 4 #NCR_PRSD
Issued at: 1:20 PM, 20 October 2026(Tuesday)

Moderate to heavy rainshowers with lightning and strong winds are expected over Quezon (Tagkawayan, Guinayangan, Buenavista, San Narciso, Mulanay, Lopez, Catanauan, Calauag, Pitogo, Gumaca, Quezon, Macalelon, General Luna, Plaridel, Atimonan, Unisan, Agdangan, and Padre Burgos) within the next 2 hours.

The above condition is affecting Quezon (San Andres and San Francisco) which may persist within 2 hours.

All are advised to take precautionary measures against the impacts associated with these hazards which include flash floods and landslides.

Keep monitoring for updates.
